seo.title: Closed Rhinoplasty in Seoul | Scarless Silicone + Ear Cartilage Method | Dr. Kim Sang-ho, Rococo Plastic Surgery
seo.description: Closed (scarless) rhinoplasty is done through the inside of the nostrils, leaving no external scar. The silicone + ear cartilage method, who it suits, limits and recovery.

hero.question: How is closed (scarless) rhinoplasty done?
hero.summary: This method applies only when a silicone implant is used: the silicone is placed somewhat long, and ear cartilage is placed on the nasal tip.
stats: Days until swelling is down enough to return to work (nose surgery only)
hero.case_caption: Retracted columella: closed rhinoplasty with silicone and ear cartilage, plus nostril and alar base reduction

features.title: This surgery has quite a lot of advantages.
items: Being a closed technique, it leaves no external scar
The nostrils barely change from the front (with septal or rib cartilage, the nostrils get pinched and pulled up to some degree)
Because the surgery does not touch the internal structures of the nose (such as the septum) at all, there is no chance of breathing discomfort after surgery
The nasal tip does not get lower over the years
It can create a naturally high nose
After surgery you can still push the tip up to some extent, as in making a "pig nose"
features.note: As I mentioned in an earlier post, quite a lot of people come to Rococo because of a retracted columella, and in many cases I recommend this closed silicone + ear cartilage surgery to people with a retracted columella.

blocks.heading: Rhinoplasty done only through the inside of the nostrils
paras: Today let's look at closed rhinoplasty, which is done only through the inside of the nostrils and leaves no scar on the outside.
For rhinoplasty using septal cartilage or rib cartilage, I operate with the open approach in every case. Open rhinoplasty is a method in which an incision is made on the columella.

blocks.heading: Noses that can be done closed
paras: For first-time surgery, I do all cases with the closed method; for revision surgery, some cases can be done closed and some need to be opened.
It works well for noses with a low bridge and a high tip.

blocks.heading: A method I have used for 17 years
paras: A senior colleague of the late Dr. Oh Young-hwan, from whom I learned nose surgery, was one of the first generation of plastic surgeons in Apgujeong. Dr. Oh learned this surgery from him, and I learned it from Dr. Oh, and I have already been performing it for 17 years, so it is truly a method with a long history.

Because its effectiveness and safety have been well proven over the many years I have operated this way, I have performed this surgery on quite a lot of my relatives, staff and close acquaintances as well.

blocks.heading: What I see as the goal of surgery
paras: After surgery the face gains dimension and looks prettier, but only pretty enough that a man meeting you for the first time would not think you had nose surgery..
A nose that doesn't look cheap.
A nose that keeps its shape well even after many years.
Personally, I think that is the best goal for surgery.

method.title: Surgical steps
steps: The closed rhinoplasty I perform uses silicone and ear cartilage.
and the nasal tip is wrapped with ear cartilage, so unlike the usual L-shaped silicone method, there is no chance of the silicone implant poking through the skin.
Although the columella was not lowered, leftover ear cartilage was placed in the columella to gain a little volume.
Swelling of the nasal tip keeps going down for up to 1 year and 6 months afterward.
method.note: After surgery, the patient's own tip cartilage can be pushed down slightly and felt inside the nostril, but as the swelling goes down between 6 and 12 months it goes back in a lot, and I have never seen it become a problem.
pros_cons: It cannot raise the tip as sharply and as much as rib cartilage
It cannot lift a downward-drooping, arrow-shaped tip up toward the glabella (between the eyebrows)
It cannot raise only the tip without silicone

recovery.title: Recovery

items.label: 5 days
lines: Face washing and makeup: from day 5
With Rococo rhinoplasty alone, the swelling goes down enough by 5 days after surgery that you can go back to work.

items.label: 1–2 weeks (with hump correction / osteotomy)
lines: In surgery like this, the surgery time is about 40 minutes and the recovery period is about 1–2 weeks.

items.label: 1 year 6 months
lines: Swelling of the nasal tip keeps going down for up to 1 year and 6 months afterward.

recovery.note: It is the least aggressive and least destructive surgery, and accordingly it is safe and recovery is quick.

faq.q: Can the tip be raised a lot with the closed method?
faq.a: It cannot raise the tip a lot in a noticeable way. It cannot lower the columella much. It can give a little volume.

faq.q: Won't breathing become uncomfortable after surgery?
faq.a: This surgery is different from the general L-shaped silicone method, and because it does not touch the internal structures of the nose at all, there are no problems such as breathing discomfort after surgery.

faq.q: Over the years, won't the tip get lower or the cartilage show through?
faq.a: The tip does not get lower over the years. As a trade-off for the tip not getting lower, there is a possibility that the tip cartilage may show through as the years pass. But that possibility is very low.

faq.q: Can a pinched nose also be corrected with the closed method?
faq.a: Correcting a pinched nose is also a surgery I perform quite often. When it is done as a standalone surgery, I usually correct it through an incision inside the nose (closed) by inserting donor dermis. No scar is left on the outside, and although the surgery is relatively simple, the correction is effective, so it is one of the surgeries with quite high patient satisfaction.

faq.q: If cartilage is removed to correct a scar inside the nose, won't the tip collapse?
faq.a: Many people ask, "If you remove the cartilage in that area, won't the tip collapse?" but that is not the case. It is the same principle as a pillar with thorns sticking out on its side: smoothing down the thorns does not make the pillar collapse.
